name: Blaude Witzch
source:
The adult body of the Ladja may be a separate person, but it is still mostly a Ladja.
For a long time, she served as an alchemist in the royal family of Lucia, and there she became close to Lala Lucia-Saint and Lula Lucia-Drait.
After so many years, she arrived in the Caucasus and, for the sake of interest, bought a serf from a landowner.
In the end, she made a worthy servant out of the serf.

Age: 35.000+
